name: Urban Intelligence
tagline: Draw a plot, check it against HMDA/NBC zoning, and get a compliant massing with a feasibility report.
description: Checks a site plot against zoning regulations (HMDA G.O.168 and NBC), auto-builds a compliant 3D massing, flags rule violations against their exact clause, and produces a feasibility and cost/revenue report as an exported PDF/DWG.

page.objective: Let a designer check a plot's development potential against zoning rules without a manual regulation lookup.
page.problem: Confirming a plot's buildable envelope against zoning rules (setbacks, height, FAR) and estimating its feasibility is normally a manual cross-check against the regulation text.
page.solution: The plot is drafted against a regulatory overlay, a compliant massing is built from it automatically, and a feasibility/cost report is exported once every rule is checked.

highlights.headline: Turns a plot boundary and zoning jurisdiction into a compliant massing and feasibility report.
points: Checks setback and height rules against a named jurisdiction (seen against HMDA G.O.168) with a violation-by-violation traceability view.
Builds a 3D massing model directly from the 2D drafted plot, with live parameter sliders.
Exports a feasibility and cost report as a PDF alongside a DWG of the massing.
